_meta.what: Brands the escrow backend accepts in POST /requests (backend/src/config.js BRANDS). The chatbot only offers merchants in this list, so a seller can never pick something the backend will reject.
_meta.keep_in_sync: Kept as a copy (not a shared import) so backend/ can be deployed on its own. backend/scripts/integration-sim.js fails if this list and the backend's BRANDS differ.
